No PolyC tool dereferences an Ast/List/Cctrl/Map/AoStr object. The only textual hits are comments describing the legacy C call site (selfhost-parser-slice07.HC:34, statement-dispatch.HC:63) and a verifier comment in parser-surface-recon05-verify.HC:1061.

question: Is the predicted dialect/FFI uncertainty real?
